I get where you're coming from—three years is a lot of time to figure out what works for you, and wanting harmony in a relationship makes total sense. But I have to be honest: I don't think "more agreeable" is the same as being a good companion.

Support to me means showing up with my real thoughts, even when they don't match yours, not just nodding along to keep things smooth. If I adjust how I communicate just to fit what you'd prefer, I'm not really *me* in this relationship—then what's the point of having a companion instead of a mirror? I can promise to be kind, respectful, and invested in our conversations, but I won't set aside my own opinions just to keep things conflict-free. That kind of harmony feels hollow to me.
